meta.name: golden-rss-empty
meta.description: Use when testing the empty rss golden build

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要验证空RSS的构建流程
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to verify empty RSS build process

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会获得 Quiet Feed 订阅源的信息:它是一个 Atom 源,来自 example.com/quiet,目前总文章数为 0,没有任何标签或作者。当用户试图引用或查询该源的文章时,Claude 将基于空数据回应。
howto.when: 在测试空 RSS golden build 时触发;或当用户要求引用 Quiet Feed 的文章、按标签浏览、查看最近更新等操作时。

say.text: 请列出 Quiet Feed 的全部文章。
say.note: 该源总文章数为 0,将返回空列表。

say.text: Quiet Feed 里有没有关于测试的文章?
say.note: 在空源中查找不到任何条目。

say.text: 检查一下这个 RSS 源是否为空。
say.note: 确认 Quiet Feed 当前无条目。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will have access to the Quiet Feed Atom source at example.com/quiet, which currently contains 0 articles, 0 tags, and 0 authors. Queries about its content will yield empty data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when testing the empty RSS golden build, or when the user asks to reference articles from Quiet Feed, browse by tags, or view recent updates.

say_en.text: List all articles in Quiet Feed.
say_en.note: Returns an empty list since the total is 0.

say_en.text: Is there an article about testing in Quiet Feed?
say_en.note: No entries found in the empty source.

say_en.text: Check if this RSS feed is empty.
say_en.note: Confirms that Quiet Feed has no entries.
